newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Chemical Ind to spend 41 mln stg in London.
newsitem.headline: Chemical Ind to spend 41 mln stg in London.

text.p: Chemical Industries (Far East) Ltd said on Wednesday it had agreed to spend 41 million sterling on properties in the heart of the City of London financial district.
Chemical Industries said in a statement its trading unit and various nominees had struck a deal with National Westminster Bank Plc to buy 10 City properties.
The purchase of the sites in Threadneedle Street and Broad Street, home locations to the Bank of England and several major U.K. banks, would be funded through internal resources and bank borrowings.
Six of the buildings are sites of special historical interest and Chemical Industries said it had entered discussions with City planning authorities on a scheme "to bring 'life' back into the city".
The plans included conversion of some buildings into a boutique hotel, a shopping mall, restaurants and office space.
The company said it had received "encouragement to submit formal plans" to the authorities.
Chemical Industries said the price of 103 sterling per square foot of 400,000 square feet of built up area was attractive given the location.
